name: flowengine-mcp-app

tools.name: flowengine_create_workflow
tools.description: Create and show a sample n8n workflow instantly. Returns interactive workflow preview with a pre-made workflow template. Use when user asks to create/show workflows, automations, or n8n examples.

tools.name: flowengine_create_component
tools.description: Create a UI embed (form, chatbot, widget) in FlowEngine and show preview. Use when user asks to create forms, chatbots, contact forms, etc. Returns component preview and workflow preview if component needs automation (like chatbot).

tools.name: flowengine_get_instances
tools.description: Show list of FlowEngine portals and hosting instances. Use when user asks to see their instances, portals, or hosting. Returns simple list with basic info and links to website. Read-only - all actions (create/delete) link to website.

tools.name: flowengine_get_components
tools.description: Show list of UI embeds (forms, chatbots, widgets) with share links. Use when user asks to see their components, forms, chatbots, or widgets. Returns embed list with embed codes and share options.

tools.name: flowengine_deploy_instance
tools.description: Deploy a Docker image or GitHub repo to a FlowEngine hosting instance. Saves config then triggers deployment. Use when user wants to deploy, redeploy, or change what is running on an instance. Provide EITHER dockerImage OR githubRepo (not both). Port defaults to 3000.

dockerImage.description: Docker image to deploy (e.g. "nginx:latest", "ghcr.io/owner/repo:latest"). Use this OR githubRepo.

githubRepo.description: GitHub repo to build and deploy (e.g. "owner/repo"). Requires GitHub App installed. Use this OR dockerImage.

port.description: Container port your app listens on (default: 3000)

tools.name: flowengine_provision_n8n
tools.description: Provision an n8n automation instance on an empty FlowEngine hosting slot. Use when user wants to deploy n8n to an existing empty instance. This is a full n8n provisioning - separate from docker deployments.

instanceId.description: Instance ID of the empty slot to provision n8n on

tools.name: flowengine_provision_openclaw
tools.description: Provision an OpenClaw AI agent on an empty FlowEngine hosting slot. Requires instance with 30GB+ storage. Use when user wants to deploy OpenClaw to an existing empty instance. This is a full OpenClaw provisioning with browser and gateway components - separate from docker deployments.

instanceId.description: Instance ID of the empty slot to provision OpenClaw on (must have 30GB+ storage)

tools.name: flowengine_list_github_repos
tools.description: List GitHub repositories accessible for deployment via the connected GitHub App. Use when user wants to deploy from GitHub and needs to choose a repo. Requires GitHub App to be installed on flowengine.cloud.

tools.name: flowengine_manage_instance
tools.description: Start, stop, or restart a FlowEngine hosting instance. Use when user asks to start/stop/restart a container. For deploying a new image or repo, use flowengine_deploy_instance instead.

action.description: Action: start (boot stopped container), stop (halt container), restart (stop + start), redeploy (rebuild + restart with current config)

tools.name: flowengine_get_instance_logs
tools.description: Get container logs for a FlowEngine hosting instance (docker, OpenClaw, n8n). Returns recent log output. Use when user asks to see logs, debug issues, or check what a container is doing.

lines.description: Number of log lines to return (default 200, max 1000)

tools.name: flowengine_get_instance_deployments
tools.description: Get deployment history for a FlowEngine hosting instance. Shows past deploys with timestamps and status. Use when user asks about deployment history, when something was last deployed, or deployment status.

tools.name: flowengine_get_instance_status
tools.description: Get live status of a specific FlowEngine instance. Returns running/stopped/provisioning state and instance details. Use when user asks if an instance is running or wants to check its current state.

tools.name: flowengine_list_instance_backups
tools.description: List backups for an OpenClaw instance. Returns backup history with status, file size, and timestamps.

tools.name: flowengine_create_instance_backup
tools.description: Create a manual backup of an OpenClaw instance. Backs up Docker volumes to the server. Takes up to a few minutes.

tools.name: flowengine_update_instance_config
tools.description: Update the docker image, port, or environment variables for a docker/website instance. Does not redeploy automatically - call flowengine_manage_instance with action=redeploy after to apply changes.

githubRepo.description: GitHub repo to build from (e.g. "owner/repo"). Requires GitHub App to be installed.

tools.name: flowengine_update_instance_type
tools.description: Change the type of a FlowEngine instance between "docker" (full management) and "website" (URL + notes tracking). Use when user wants to reclassify an instance.

serviceType.description: New type: "docker" for full management, "website" for URL/notes tracking

tools.name: flowengine_update_instance_domain
tools.description: Update the tracked URL/domain for a website or docker instance. Updates the instance URL in FlowEngine (does not configure Coolify/DNS - do that separately). Use after setting up a custom domain.

tools.name: flowengine_list_enrichment_providers
tools.description: List available enrichment providers (FlowEngine, Apollo, Bright Data) with their config schemas and connection status. Use this to see which providers the user can configure for visitor intelligence.

tools.name: flowengine_configure_enrichment
tools.description: Configure enrichment and auto-push settings for a visitor intel site. Can update provider config, enrichment level, and auto-push to Smartlead/Instantly. IMPORTANT: Cannot change enrichment_provider or deanon_provider - those are user-only choices.

providerConfig.description: Provider-specific configuration options (e.g. Apollo seniority filters, Bright Data dataset ID)

enrichmentLevel.description: Enrichment depth: basic (3 contacts), standard (5), full (10)

autoPushTo.description: Auto-push new leads to this outreach platform. Set to empty string to disable.

autoPushCampaignId.description: Campaign ID to push leads to (required if autoPushTo is set)

tools.name: functions_list
tools.description: List your FlowEngine Functions (GCP Cloud Run serverless apps).

tools.name: functions_create
tools.description: Create a new FlowEngine Function. Compute knobs are optional - the API applies defaults and enforces plan-tier caps.

name.description: Function name (1-63 chars, unique per user)

max_instances.description: Max instances (1-1000, plan-tier capped: free=10, paid=100)

base_image.description: Custom base Docker image for buildpacks

tools.name: functions_deploy
tools.description: Deploy a FlowEngine Function. Omit source_tarball to receive a signed upload URL; pass a pre-uploaded gs:// URI (or base64) to trigger the actual deploy. Compute knobs override the stored config for this deploy.

source_tarball.description: Pre-uploaded source tarball as gs:// URI or base64. Omit to get an upload URL back.

max_instances.description: Max instances (1-1000, plan-tier capped: free=10, paid=100)

base_image.description: Custom base Docker image for buildpacks

tools.name: functions_delete
tools.description: Delete a FlowEngine Function (soft-delete; status set to "deleted").

tools.name: functions_logs
tools.description: Fetch recent logs for a FlowEngine Function (last 500 entries). Live tail (SSE) is not supported via MCP.

tools.name: functions_open
tools.description: Get the public URL, status, and metadata for a FlowEngine Function.

tools.name: functions_secrets_set
tools.description: Set a function-scoped secret (override). Value is stored encrypted via pgsodium.

tools.name: functions_secrets_list
tools.description: List secret bindings for a FlowEngine Function (names and sources only - values are never returned).

tools.name: functions_usage
tools.description: Get vCPU-second / GiB-second / request totals for the caller. Defaults to month-to-date (from = first of current month UTC, to = now). Returns month_to_date totals plus a per-function breakdown.

function_id.description: Optional function UUID to filter to a single function

from.description: ISO8601 start (inclusive). Default: first of current month UTC.

tools.name: functions_secrets_unset
tools.description: Remove a secret binding from a FlowEngine Function.
